lines.en: My scales glitter as I walk.
My four feet land softly.
My tail sweeps the fallen leaves aside.
The grass looks brighter where I pass.

lines.zh: 我比哥布林大，可我不吵
lines.en: I'm bigger than a goblin, and quieter.
I keep low, wings folded.

lines.zh: 这条路是哥布林踩出来的
lines.en: Goblins made this trail.
My tail swings before I turn.
Near the village, I slow down.
I check the ground before stepping.

lines.zh: 把他叼过来，不费什么力
lines.en: Carrying one over costs me little.

lines.zh: 闻到肉味，我的步子就快
lines.en: Smelling meat, my pace quickens.
I crouch, scales still shining.

lines.zh: 哥布林肉的味道我记着
lines.en: I remember the taste of goblin meat.
I rest my head on a forepaw.
The light on my back shifts with the wind.
I'm waiting for someone to raise a hand.

lines.zh: 这一带的哥布林都躲着我
lines.en: The goblins here avoid me.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，火花溅出来
lines.en: I sneeze and sparks fly.
My wings are folded, still useful.
My shadow is bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 远处有人在丢东西，我听见
lines.en: Someone's tossing things far off; I hear it.
I'm not sleepy, just unwilling to move.
I scratched at the dirt.

lines.zh: 山的影子落在背上，很凉
lines.en: The hill's shadow falls on my back, cool.

lines.zh: 你身上没有哥布林的味
lines.en: You don't smell of goblin.
I'm in no hurry to eat you.
My talent is fetching things.
Raise your hand and I'll understand.
A shiny scale doesn't mean tame.
You're taller than a goblin, good.
Whether I bite depends on your hand.
Don't touch my back; it's hot.
I'm looking at your belt.

lines.zh: 你身后那只哥布林，我先看到
lines.en: The goblin behind you, I saw first.
I don't roar; I never roar.
Stand still, let me sniff.
If you feed me, I'll stay.
Your hands have handled meat.
I turn my head and watch you.
A white line on my scales.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，光暗了一点
lines.en: I took half a step; my light dimmed.
It doesn't hurt, only looks bad.
That scattered my light.
I lower myself flat.
A small scale came off.
I make a low sound.
Hit again and I'll bite.
The wound is hot.
Goblin meat; I know that smell.
That piece in your hand, give it.
Raw is best.

lines.zh: 你举高了，我可跳得上去
lines.en: Hold it high; I can jump for it.
One isn't enough; I want two.
Where did that meat come from?
I sniffed it; it will do.
Put it down and I'll eat slowly.
Eat yours, and I'll follow you.
Don't pass off other meat.
Bump me and you'll be thrown back.
My scales are hard.
Don't lean on my wings.
That'll leave your legs weak.
I back off and leave a path.
My feet land with a thud.
Everything you touch is hot.
Make room, this body takes space.
Without effort, you stepped back.
I don't much care about that.
There are other Glitterons in the hills.

lines.zh: 我们对哥布林的看法一样
lines.en: We agree about goblins.
Scales meeting make a sound.
We won't stay together long.

lines.zh: 那点光是我的，也是它的
lines.en: That light is mine, and its.
Watch if you like, don't interfere.
I follow a master, not a mate.
The hill wind drowns out speech.
It left, and I don't chase.
I brought this arrowhead back.

lines.zh: 掉在远处的东西，我去拿
lines.en: Something fell far off; I'll fetch it.
My mouth can hold several.
Dropped things shouldn't be wasted.
I gather the arrows one by one.
Too heavy; I push it with a claw.

lines.zh: 找到主人的东西，我就回来
lines.en: I find my master's things and return.
All of these on the ground, I'll take.
I can't grip this.
One trip, one trip is enough.
Something fell over there.
I saw it, shiny.
Run over first, talk later.
That arrowhead, I want it.
Goblin, here I come.
Right direction, not far.
This time, the pickup first.
I raise my head, ears forward.
That one.
No roar; I just go.
Someone seeing it first doesn't help them.
I route around the rocks.
The direction my master pointed.
I run there close to the ground.
Forepaw down first, steady.
A stretch still to go.
It rolled into the grass.
I skirt the roots.
The wind flattens the grass; I can see.
The goblin's running, and slowly.
I approach quietly.
It hasn't noticed me.
Almost there.
I open my mouth and go slow.
Land light, don't spook it.
Tail tucked, don't brush anything.
It looked back.
One more step.
One quick bite.
A forepaw presses down.
My tail whips across, hard.
Sparks came off that one.
It's flung and rolls.
I don't chase; it won't get far.
There's some fur in my mouth.
One shove and it's three steps back.
Not graceful, but enough.
I raise my head and watch it flee.
My bite is enough; the bone will crack.
One bite and it stops moving.
I dislike drawing things out.
I shake off what's on my snout.

lines.zh: 鳞片先亮起来，我才站稳
lines.en: My scales lit first, then I steadied.

lines.zh: 哥布林的肉味把我引来了。
lines.en: The smell of goblin meat brought me here.
A new line of prints on the ground.
Plenty of goblins here, good.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，光落下来
lines.en: I shake my wings and light falls.
Someone raised a hand in the distance.
I slide down the slope.
This place smells of many things.
I stand and survey the surroundings.
This shine can't be hidden.
This is the first time I've smelled this place.

lines.zh: 前面有人，我不急着过去
lines.en: Someone's ahead; I don't rush over.
This step holds.

lines.zh: 哥布林的味道，从那边来的
lines.en: The goblin smell comes from over there.
I'm here; better feed me.

lines.zh: 火对我不算什么，只是更亮
lines.en: Fire is nothing to me; it only makes me brighter.
I land on my claws first.
Water dims my shine.
The blast rolled me half a turn.
The arrow bounced off my scales.

lines.zh: 法术打在我身上，光乱跳
lines.en: The spell hit and my light jumped wildly.
When I'm hungry, my light dims.
Lightning struck and every scale lit.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有光，我很难受
lines.en: No light in the void; it hurts me.
